title: Completed scalar restriction is faithful on single sheaves
statement: Let l be prime and X a scheme with the recorded diagonal derived localizations. For completed coefficient modules M,N and arrows f,g:M[0]→N[0], equality after diagonalCompletedUnderlying implies f=g.

source.place: paragraph (2), reflecting the completed degree-zero identity

proof.text: Ordinary completed scalar restriction retains the same sectionwise functions and is faithful. Fullness writes the derived arrows as single images of module maps. Naturality of the exact single comparison and faithfulness of singleFunctor reduce equality to faithful ordinary restriction.

theorem diagonalTrace_single_map_injective (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] {M N : DiagonalCompleted l X}
    (f g : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalCompleted l X) 0).obj M ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalCompleted l X) 0).obj N)
    (h : (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l X).map f =
      (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l X).map g) : f = g
